name: Naughty 40
source:
Only a small portion of high society is visible to you. When you see them in their actual hues, you'll be amazed at how nasty they are. The series centers around Grace and her husband, Mark. With the additional features that have been added to the game, you'll feel like you're in command of a popular television program.
